title: Endogenous Selection and Spillovers: Bayesian Inference for Policy-Relevant Causal Effects
abstract: arXiv:2608.25720v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper develops a new econometric framework to identify and estimate policy-relevant causal effects in contexts with endogenous selection into treatment and spillovers within single large networks or spatial settings. Conventional causal inference methods relying on either unconfoundedness or no-interference assumptions are generally inadequate in these scenarios. We introduce a Spillover Roy model that jointly models endogenous treatment selection and potential outcomes while allowing spillovers through a low-dimensional exposure mapping of neighbors' treatments. The model captures heterogeneous treatment responses across levels of latent resistance to treatment and neighborhood exposure. Within this framework, we define policy-relevant direct, spillover, and total effects under feasible policy changes and show that the total effect decomposes into a direct component from policy-induced participation and a spillover component from p

translated_title: 内生选择与溢出效应：政策相关因果效应的贝叶斯推断
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个新的计量经济学框架，用于在存在内生治疗选择和大规模网络或空间设置中溢出效应的情境下，识别和估计政策相关的因果效应。依赖于无混杂性或无干扰性假设的传统因果推断方法在这些场景中通常不适用。我们引入了一个Spillover Roy模型，该模型联合建模内生治疗选择和潜在结果，同时通过邻居治疗的低维暴露映射允许溢出效应。该模型捕捉了不同潜在治疗抵抗水平和邻里暴露水平下的异质性治疗反应。在此框架内，我们定义了在可行政策变化下的政策相关直接效应、溢出效应和总效应，并表明总效应可分解为政策诱导参与的直接成分和来自政策诱导参与的溢出成分。
tldr: 本文提出了一种新的贝叶斯计量框架，通过Spillover Roy模型联合处理内生选择和溢出效应，以识别和估计政策相关的直接、溢出及总因果效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel Bayesian econometric framework that jointly handles endogenous selection and spillovers via a Spillover Roy model to identify and estimate policy-relevant direct, spillover, and total causal effects.
